en.hubeali: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said:
‘When the deceased is washed, then excretes after the washing, so the excretion should be washed off, and the (whole) washing would not be repeated’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
After Ghusl (bath), if something happens, only that part is washed and repeating Ghusl (bath) is not required.’”
